lf-select.description: One choice from a dropdown, drawn by Web Awesome's select, a component that knows nothing of Leaf. Put it in an `lf-group` whose label asks the question, with a `wa-option` for each choice.
lf-select.example: <lf-group id="plan" label="Which plan?"><lf-select id="plan-choice" placeholder="Choose a plan"><wa-option value="starter">Starter</wa-option><wa-option value="team">Team</wa-option></lf-select></lf-group>

lf-level.description: A level on a scale, set on a range the element holds, which says `level-change` at every change of its value, a script's set included.
